visualCharacteristics.purpose: Inline PDF viewer for a downloadable guide, with the download link below
visualCharacteristics.layout: full content width, A4 portrait ratio, rounded white frame; download button centred below

contentPattern.structure: single cell: a link to the .pdf (link text = download label); optional paragraph = accessible title of the viewer

reuseGuidance: Upload the PDF to the site so it is served from the same origin; cross-origin PDFs may be blocked from inline display.
